profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Alkami Technology
profile.summary:
Full stack software engineer
Node.js, MongoDB, GraphQL, React.js, Formik, Figma, Github Actions, Cypress, Jira

Former analytical chemist, won over by the engaging world of software development. Passionate about life-long learning, coding, computer science, roller derby, and playing the drums.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- React.js, Apollo GraphQL, Node.js, MongoDB, Styled Components, deck.gl, Mapbox, Formik, Figma, GitHub Actions, Cypress, Jira.
- Architected, built, QAed, deployed, and debugged full stack features, while adjusting to changing priorities in a fast-paced startup environment.
- Led redesign of the booking schema to allow single payment for multiple flights. Included rearchitecture of the core booking functionality, implementation, and QA. Deployment was successful with no major regressions.
- Architected and built a tiered membership program for customers that includes All-You-Can-Fly and Pay-As-You-Fly options, and discounted fares for members.
- Debugged and fixed a React/DOM performance issue that arose from increased scale of aircraft and operators on the platform.
- Built a webhook that triggers various actions in response to Stripe payment events.
- Architected and implemented the ability to pay by wire transfer on fly.surfair.com, which allows customers to save 2.5% on charter flights and bypass credit card processing fees.

positions.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
positions.description:
- React.js, Apollo GraphQL, Node.js, MongoDB, Styled Components, deck.gl, Mapbox, Formik, Figma, GitHub Actions, Cypress, Jira.
- Turned Figma designs into responsive, pixel perfect full stack features for the Surf Air marketplace website fly.surfair.com.
- Built full stack features with intuitive UI/UX for the internal customer and booking management dashboard, all based on user stories without visual design documents.

positions.title: Junior Full Stack Software Engineer
positions.description:
-  React.js, React Native, Apollo GraphQL, Node.js, MongoDB, Styled Components, deck.gl, Mapbox, Figma, Jira.
- As part of a 3 person team, built an interactive map-based airline booking system that led to successful acquisition of the company, and which became the core customer system of Surf Air.
- Used Jira to balance development, QA, and deployment of full stack features with squashing bugs in both the customer facing mobile app and the internal web application.
- Created dynamic user-friendly React Native scenes that fit on many different Android and iOS devices.

positions.title: Analytical Chemist
positions.description:
- Utilized the ChemStation software package to generate and analyze chromatographic data in order to precisely quantify compounds in drug products and assess stability over time.
- Accurately prepared dozens of drug product samples in a single day with precision results of <0.1% relative standard deviation for triplicate preparations.
- Adhered to strict federal regulations for laboratory work, documentation, and data collection practices in an FDA audited GMP laboratory.

projects.title: Scout My Skate
projects.description:
* A full stack single page clone based on the site, Map My Run
* Incorporated the Google Maps API to create interactive maps that allow users to draw custom routes that snap to roads, and save/retrieve them from the database.
* Used the Google Maps Geolocation services to automatically center maps on the user’s location, and the Google Places Autocomplete API to create a user friendly location search option.
* Implemented back end user authentication with password encryption, and bootstrapped users on the front end by creating a preloaded state for the Redux store with the current user’s id.
* Created protected frontend routes using React Router components to control access to private user content.
* Used CSS media queries to create a beautiful and responsive UI that scales to any device size.

projects.title: Piano Play
projects.description:
* A fun interactive piano app that allows user to make music with their keyboard or mouse. 
* Generated HTML audio elements and SVG shapes for 31 piano keys using JavaScript, resulting in clean and DRY code.
* Utilized session storage to save the user selected keyboard voice so that audio output changed accordingly.
* Designed a fun and flexible UX that allows users to choose between keyboard and mouse input.
